# Atlas Engineering

> Atlas Engineering is a premier heavy machinery manufacturer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, established in 1997. Specializing in high-performance Bitumen Modify Equipment, Road Construction Machinery, and Cement Concrete Equipment.

## Product Categories & Machinery

### Bitumen Modify Equipment
- [Bitumen Emulsion Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/bitumen-emulsion-plant): Continuous and batch emulsion plants with capacities from 5 to 30 TPH. Features high-shear colloid mill for rapid emulsification.
- [PMB / CRMB Bitumen Modify Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/pmb-crmb-bitumen-modify-plant): Polymer Modified Bitumen (SBS, EVA) and Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen plants with high-shear polymer dispersion.
- [Bitumen Air Blowing (Oxidization) Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/bitumen-air-blowing-oxidization-plant): Industrial bitumen blowing unit for producing industrial grade and blown bitumen.
- [Cold Mix Asphalt Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/cold-mix-asphalt-plant): Eco-friendly cold mix production systems for pothole repair and rural road construction.
- [Bitumen Storage Tank](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/bitumen-storage-tank): Thermic oil heated or direct-fired bitumen storage tanks from 15 to 50 MT capacity.
- [Emulsion Storage Horizontal Tank](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/emulsion-storage-horizontal-type-tank): Dedicated horizontal tanks with slow-speed paddle agitators to prevent emulsion breakdown.
- [Emulsion & Bitumen Drum Filling Machine](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/emulsion-and-bitumen-drum-filling-machine): High-precision automated filling systems for 200L standard barrels.
- [Asphalt Cold Mix Material Bag Filling Machine](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/asphalt-cold-mix-material-bag-filling-machine): Weighing and packaging machinery for commercial retail pothole repair mixes.
- [Hot Thermic Fluid Heater](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/hot-thermic-fluid-heater): High-efficiency thermal oil boilers from 100,000 to 1,500,000 kcal/hr.
- [Turnkey Project](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/turnkey-project): Complete EPC design, fabrication, civil engineering, and commissioning for bitumen terminals.

### Road Construction Equipment
- [Asphalt Batch Mix Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/asphalt-batch-mix-plant): High precision tower-type asphalt plants (80 to 260 TPH) with screen decks and pugmill mixers.
- [Asphalt Drum Mix Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/asphalt-drum-mix-plant): Continuous asphalt drum mixing plants (40 to 150 TPH) with dual-drum technology.
- [Mobile Drum Mix Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/mobile-drum-mix-plant): Portable chassis-mounted asphalt plants designed for rapid transport across remote highway sites.
- [Wet Mix Plant (WMM Plant)](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/wet-mix-plant-wmm): Wet Mix Macadam plants (100 to 250 TPH) ensuring accurate moisture control and pugmill mixing.
- [Asphalt Paver Finisher](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/asphalt-paver-finisher): Mechanical and hydrostatic sensor pavers for uniform bituminous and aggregate paving.
- [Bitumen Truck Mounted Sprayer](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/bitumen-truck-mounted-sprayer): Hydraulic spray bars with variable spray widths and constant pressure for tack coat and prime coat.
- [Bitumen Mini Tractor Linked Sprayer](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/bitumen-mini-tractor-linked-sprayer): Tractor-towed pressure distributors ideal for village roads, service roads, and narrow lanes.

### Cement & Concrete Equipment
- [Cement Concrete Batching Plant](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/cement-concrete-batching-plant): Stationary and mobile concrete batching plants with planetary or twin-shaft mixers (30 to 90 m³/hr).
- [Cement & Fly Ash Storage Silo](https://www.atlasbitumenplant.com/products/cement-fly-ash-silo): Welded and bolted silos with fluidization pads, dust filters, and safety pressure valves (50 to 200 MT).

- Global Export Footprint: Machines deployed in 15+ countries across Asia, Africa, and the Middle East
